meta.description: Convert US Gallon (gal) to US Quart (qt) instantly. 1 gal = 4 qt. Free, accurate, engineering-grade precision.

content.intro: Convert us gallons (gal) to us quarts (qt) instantly. Both measure volume, so the relationship is strictly linear: each us gallon equals 4 us quarts. Use the converter above for any value, or read on for the formula, a quick lookup table, and practical tips.
content.result_section: One us gallon is equal to **4 us quarts**. To go the other way, one us quart equals **0.25 us gallons**. For everyday use, rounding to 2–4 decimal places is usually enough; for engineering or scientific work, keep the full precision shown by the converter.
content.formula_section:
The conversion is a single multiplication:

> us quarts = us gallons × 4

Worked example — converting 10 us gallons:

10 × 4 = **40 qt**.

To invert, divide by 4 (or multiply by 0.25).

content.tips:
Keep the factor handy: 1 gal ≈ 4 qt. For rough mental math, round to the nearest sensible digit.

Mind the units. US Gallon and US Quart both measure volume; squared or cubic variants need a different factor (factor², factor³).

When precision matters (engineering, lab work, dosing), avoid rounding mid-calculation — convert once at the final step using the full factor.
content.faq:
**Q:** How many us quarts are in 1 us gallon?
**A:** 4 us quarts.

**Q:** What's the formula to convert gal to qt?
**A:** us quarts = us gallons × 4.

**Q:** How do I convert qt back to gal?
**A:** Multiply by 0.25 (or divide by 4).

**Q:** Is rounding to 2 decimal places accurate enough?
**A:** For most everyday uses, yes. For scientific or engineering work, use the full precision from the converter.

**Q:** Does this gal to qt converter work offline?
**A:** Yes — all math runs in your browser, no network required after the page loads.
